news.headline: TCG Crossover and Invus Public Equities disclose large passive stakes in Abivax
news.summary: Amended 13G filings show TCG Crossover funds holding an aggregate ~7.0% and Invus Public Equities entities holding ~6.0% of Abivax shares, underscoring continued heavy crossover/institutional ownership ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax announces positive pre-NDA interaction with the FDA for obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback aligning on the planned content, format and strategy of the obefazimod NDA in ulcerative colitis, keeping the company on track for a late-Q4 2026 submission.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132, keeps Overweight
news.summary: The upgrade cited growing confidence in obefazimod's regulatory and commercial path following the positive ABTECT maintenance safety data.

news.headline: Abivax strengthens commercial capabilities with strategic leadership appointments
news.summary: Four new commercial leaders hired from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie and Eli Lilly to build out marketing, sales, market access and patient services ahead of a planned US launch.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics announces exclusive R&D collaboration with Abivax on next-gen inflammatory disease candidates
news.summary: Binding term sheet for a worldwide research collaboration pairing Abivax's expertise with Valerio's RNA-targeting platform to identify next-generation immune-disease candidates; Valerio gets a ~€2.4M upfront plus milestones and royalties.

news.headline: Abivax closes $920 million public offering
news.summary: Closed upsized ADS offering for ~$920M gross/$874M net (underwriters' option fully exercised), extending cash runway into Q4 2029 to fund a potential solo US launch.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following the positive pre-NDA meeting, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA by the end of Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results / corporate update
catalysts.detail: Abivax's half-year 2026 results release, typically paired with a pipeline and cash-runway update.

catalysts.label: EMA marketing authorization application (MAA) filing
catalysts.detail: Company intends to file the EU MAA alongside the US NDA.

catalysts.label: Lead combination-therapy candidate selection
catalysts.detail: Plan to select a lead obefazimod combination-therapy candidate, potentially informed by the new Valerio R&D collaboration.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease 12-week induction data
catalysts.detail: Topline induction readout for obefazimod in Crohn's disease; enrollment began Q3 2024.

catalysts.label: Takeover/partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Recurring market chatter (incl. earlier Eli Lilly reports, denied/unconfirmed by French Treasury) about a large-pharma acquisition or partnership.

pulse: As of August 26, 2026, Abivax is executing cleanly toward its late-Q4 2026 FDA NDA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, having banked positive pre-NDA FDA feedback, closed a $920M raise, built out a US commercial leadership team, and signed a new R&D collaboration (Valerio) to feed its next-gen pipeline. Sell-side conviction remains strong (Morgan Stanley PT raised to $180) and large crossover/institutional holders (TCG Crossover, Invus) continue to hold sizable stakes, while recurring big-pharma takeover chatter (e.g., earlier Eli Lilly reports) keeps a speculative premium in the stock. The next dated milestones are H1 2026 results on September 21 and the Q4 2026 NDA submission, with the EU MAA filing and Crohn's disease Phase 2b data (mid-2027) further out.
